Museum of Zoology
Museum of Zoology is a hidden treasure in the middle of the city of Leuven. A unique place where you will find a collection of wondrous creatures from all corners of the world.
Discover more
Beastly heritage seeks support: The museum has great scientific and important heritage values but unfortunately is not subsidised. To continue our mission and keep our doors open to everyone, we rely on support from our visitors. You are most welcome to support us!
